title: Blue Mountain Beach 19 Sandcastle Court
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Walking distance to the beach- Private pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $30 per day**- Third-floor entertainment room with pool table- Outdoor living space- 4 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 3 dedicated parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Take a deep breath and escape. Leave the noise and stress behind and relax in your private home featuring its own private pool. This home can easily sleep 3 families with room to spare. This home has a lot to offer - spacious accommodations with flat-screen TV's, king-size beds, and local amenities close by. Sandcastle Court is located on the south side of 30A and is about one block to Mexico's Gulf.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Hall Bath with shower/tub comboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Attached Bath w/ separate shower, and tub- Bunk Room: 2 sets of bunks: Twins-over-Full Beds w/Twin trundles with attached bath with shower onlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Hall Bath w/Shower Only- Entertainment Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa with shared Hall Bath Parties, weddings or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing. Fees apply.
